# HoDoKu2 vendor artifact

This directory contains the fixed HoDoKu2 binary used only by the offline puzzle build tool.

- Version: `2.4.3`, build `116`
- Upstream: <https://github.com/wyzelli/Hodoku2>
- JAR SHA-256: `b0d3e2f6e82100a51c1a4c44b590cb03a9aad36aed6663cca490e83051a7c66d`
- License: GPL-3.0; see `LICENSE`
- Runtime: Java 21 or newer

The JAR is not linked into or distributed with the React Native application. Only the generated content database is an application resource.
